map.焊接工艺参数计算（电流/电压/热输入） 使用指南: Welding Parameter Calculation (Current/Voltage/Heat Input) User Guide
map.算法：电流 I = 板厚×方法系数（SMAW45/TIG60/MIG100）；电: Algorithm: current I = plate thickness x method coefficient (SMAW 45 / TIG 60 / MIG 100); voltage takes the mid-value of the method range; welding speed takes the mid-value of its range; heat input HJ = I x U / (welding speed x 1000) (kJ/mm); number of passes = ceil(plate thickness/4).
map.按板厚与焊接方法计算焊接电流与电压: Compute welding current and voltage from plate thickness and welding method
map.按板厚估算焊道层数: Estimate the number of weld passes from plate thickness
map.支持不同焊接方法的参数比选: Supports parameter comparison across different welding methods
map.焊接工艺评定：输入板厚与 method，算焊接电流、电压与热输入: Welding procedure qualification: enter plate thickness and method to compute welding current, voltage and heat input
map.热输入控制：热输入影响熔深、变形与热影响区: Heat input control: heat input affects penetration, distortion and the heat-affected zone
map.层数估算：厚板按每层约 4mm 定焊道数: Layer estimation: for thick plate set the number of passes at about 4 mm per layer
map.输入板厚与坡口形式: Enter plate thickness and groove type
map.选择焊接方法（手工电弧焊/埋弧焊/MIG 等）: Select the welding method (shielded metal arc / submerged arc / MIG and so on)
map.点击计算，读取电流、电压与热输入: Click calculate to read current, voltage and heat input
map.按每层约 4mm 估算焊道数并复核工艺规程: Estimate passes at about 4 mm per layer and re-check against the procedure specification
map.热输入依材料与厚度：低碳钢一般 0.5~2.5 kJ/mm 为宜: Heat input depends on material and thickness: for mild steel generally 0.5-2.5 kJ/mm is appropriate
map.热输入过高热影响区大、易裂；过低则未焊透: Too high heat input enlarges the heat-affected zone and causes cracking; too low gives incomplete penetration
map.焊道数按板厚/4 估算，实际受坡口与摆宽影响: Pass count is estimated as plate thickness / 4, but is actually affected by groove and weave width
map.参数须经焊接工艺评定确认后方可用于正式生产: Parameters may only be used in formal production after confirmation by welding procedure qualification
map.热输入多少合适？: How much heat input is appropriate?
map.依材料与厚度：低碳钢一般 0.5~2.5kJ/mm；过高热影响区大、易裂，过低未: Depends on material and thickness: for mild steel generally 0.5-2.5 kJ/mm; too high gives a large heat-affected zone and cracking, too low gives incomplete penetration, so follow the procedure specification.
map.焊道数为什么按板厚/4？: Why is the number of passes plate thickness / 4?
map.单道焊熔深有限（约 4mm），厚板须多道多层；实际还受坡口与摆宽影响。: A single pass has limited penetration (about 4 mm), so thick plate needs multiple passes and layers; groove and weave width also matter in practice.
